ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-orange soft cooked egg mass, fluffy and curd-like with small rounded clumps and folds, moist-looking with slight sheen, no visible browning, forming a central cluster about 9 cm across with scattered pieces spreading toward the left and bottom of a square white plate about 26 cm wide, roughly 2 cm thick at the mound | 190
ITEM 2 | Small loose crumbles of the same pale yellow soft curd scattered around the lower-left of the mound, each piece about 1 to 2 cm, crumbly and irregular, no browning, sitting directly on the white plate | 25
